data.long_description:
Provident Real Estate is proud to present this elegant 1-bedroom apartment for rent in Harbour Views Tower 1, Dubai Creek Harbour.

Situated on a mid-floor level with peaceful community views, this well-planned apartment offers a bright and spacious living environment designed for comfort and convenience. The open-plan living and dining area is complemented by large windows that fill the home with natural light. The furnished layout provides a stylish, move-in-ready space.
Located in the heart of Dubai Creek Harbour, residents enjoy a vibrant waterfront lifestyle with easy access to retail, dining, parks, and leisure attractions.

Property Features:

1 Bedroom
1 Bathroom
Size: 729 sq. ft.
Furnished
Vacant soon

Community view
